schwalbeCircumference.title: Schwalbe Tire Circumference Chart & Bike Computer Setup
schwalbeCircumference.description: Find approximate Schwalbe wheel circumference in mm by ETRTO and inch size for Garmin, Wahoo and other bike computers. Measure a loaded wheel roll-out for precise calibration.
schwalbeCircumference.imageAlt: Schwalbe bicycle tire circumference reference chart with inch sizes, ETRTO sizes and approximate circumference in millimeters.

tireSizeMarkings.title: Bicycle Tire Size Conversion: ETRTO, Inches & French
tireSizeMarkings.description: Read bicycle tire size markings and compare ETRTO/ISO, inch and French sizes, including 700C, 650B and 29 inch. Check bead seat diameter before matching a tire to a rim.
tireSizeMarkings.imageAlt: Bicycle tire size chart comparing ETRTO/ISO, inch and French tire markings.

tubeless.title: Bicycle Tubeless Tire Installation: Tape, Valves & Sealant
tubeless.description: Learn bicycle tubeless tire basics and installation: prepare the rim, apply tape, fit the valve, mount the tire, add sealant and inflate. Check tire and rim compatibility before setup.
tubeless.imageAlt: Bicycle tubeless tire installation diagram showing tire mounting and bead seating on the rim.

tirePressure.title: Bicycle Tire Pressure Guide: Rider Weight, Width & Terrain
tirePressure.description: Understand how rider weight, tire width, terrain and rim design affect bicycle tire pressure. Review pressure and contact-area demonstrations, and follow the exact tire and rim manufacturer limits.

innerTubeCalculator.title: Bicycle Inner Tube Valve Length & Extender Calculator
innerTubeCalculator.description: Calculate inner tube valve and extender lengths for deep rims using rim depth, pump head grip and measurement uncertainty. Compare automatic recommendations and manual fit checks.

innerTube.title: Bicycle Inner Tube Sizes & Valve Calculator
innerTube.description: Compare Presta, Schrader and Dunlop valves, choose TPU, latex or butyl, and estimate valve length for deep rims. Includes ETRTO sizing guidance.
innerTube.imageAlt: Bicycle inner tube guide: Presta, Schrader and Dunlop valves, tube materials, and a rim-depth and exposed-valve diagram.
